comment: Grading was very subjective . If you make points that he does not agree with, he will flat-out tell you that you are wrong.  Three essays (along with participation) make up your entire grade, and he's a difficult grader. I got an A and two B+s on my essays and ended up with a B-, so a lot of your grade depends on how he feels about you.
If you don't take advantage of him willing to proofread your rough drafts, which can bring your grade up by at least a letter, you shouldn't take his class or go to this school.
Narrow-minded. If you don't say exactly what he wants to hear in class discussion he will tell you that you are wrong. Extremely boring and does not seem to care in the slightest about his students,

Very nice guy--clearly very knowledgeable. Classes were mostly discussion based though sometimes they became lectures (not complaining--Dr. Hilliard's stories and thoughts are great to listen to). Weekly writing assignments are good for practicing writing but sometimes I wish there was a little more feedback. Overall definitely take his class!

Dr. Hilliard expects a lot out of his students. If you aren't prepared to read dense material each night then this class might not be for you. With that being said, anyone who genuinely wants to improve their writing needs to take Dr. Hilliard's class! He will challenge you at a level that is appropriate considering your abilities - it's worth it

when he first walked in the room i was thinking oh hes a cute old guy ... this is gonna be eeeaaasyyy but turns out i  was wrong. not saying that hes unreasonable. hes very fun and gives lots of time for essays and such but his class is to be taken seriously. glad i took the course. the books were mostly awesome!

Dr. Hilliard is an extremely intelligent yet frustrating man. While he genuinely does try to convey his opinions in a neutral and fair manner, it is apparent that if you are not in love with the idea of English and literature, or share the same sentiment towards the topic during that time you will not do well. The class also has 10 different books.

Nice man. Class was held with the students in a circle  discussing the books. Discussions were normally students making comments on readings (little back and forth). He expects good participation and timeliness. He will improve your writing; he gives you lots of feedback. Sometimes dull, but he really helps you understand books. Overall good.

He is one of the best professors I had this past semester. He is always extremely helpful, nice, makes it a point to get to know you, and tries to do what is best for you. Participation is big in his class; if you don't participate he will pick on you.
Great person, dedicated to his students, loves class participation, tough grader.

He is a great professor!!! I recommend him to anyone who needs to take English. He loves the topic of love and Eros so you will be thoroughly entertained as well as learning a lot from great novels, as the class is rightly named.  He helps with your writing skills as well and gives great tips. Prof Hilliard also is able to tell who is invested in his class and he does reward those who do very well and tries hard. Best course of my semester!!

Professor Hilliard is really a great teacher. He's nice and tries to be as engaging as possible. I'm taking his class as a gen ed requirement but its a worthwhile class to take. Its generally easy but he expects you to do the reading, which can add up if you dont.

Dr. Hilliard is one of the smartest people I've ever encountered. He has many interesting things to say, but if you're not interested in what you read, then you probably will not enjoy his class. He expects you to write meaningful essays, and if you can make them flow, then you'll be fine. Talk to him outside of class. You'll find him quite funny.

A tough grader, but a fair one. Read the books, participate in class, and try your best on the essays, and you'll get an A. He is keenly interested in what the students have to say, and about their lives outside of class.
Dr. Hilliard is the toughest professor I have ever had. He grades really tough and expects you to put in hours and hours for all assignments.

He is a good teacher. He is hilarious in lectures, and tries his hardest to be involved/interested in his students lives.  He talks about his cats alot.  Do the reading, and speak up in class. When writing papers, make sure you pay attention to the actual topic and you'll be fine.

Hilliard is the man, an absolute genius and a great person. He is hard though, and is extremely specific in what he expects from you as a student. However, i may have learned more from him than any other professor here at Richmond. A MUST TAKE professor just try not to take 4 sciences when you do.

Wonderful professor. Great discussion facilitator. Clear and analytical in his interpretations of deep, thought-provoking texts. Definitely knows his away around in the CORE course and makes it one of the best first-year academic experiences at UoR. Very helpful with papers. You will learn a lot in (and enjoy) his CORE class.

Great, inspirational teacher. Pushes you very hard but you certainly grow as a thinker and writer. He's unintentionally hilarious and his discussions are thought-provoking. VERY concerned with his students extracurricular affairs (in a good way). I'd definitely recommend him!
Great professor, you have to do the reading though, not an easy A, but I ended up with an A for my 3rd paper, so hard work pays.
Do not get him to tell you jokes. They are awful

i didn't do any of the reading and wrote all my papers the night before at 1 AM and did very well.  not difficult, but you learn a lot.  his comments in class are very odd/hilarious though.  i think i'm actually gonna miss him

i actually thought his class was ok until he unfairly slammed me on my final term paper. he was shockingly insulting and presumptuous, not to mention incorrect in much of what he said. i thought the class was decent, but clearly what i got out of it wasn't what he expects. be cautious.
Worst teacher I've ever had.  Very unfriendly, talks too much, expects you to think exactly like he does.  Insulting.  Do not take this course with him.

Professor Hilliard is very demanding, but in general is a great professor.  It took me a while to get used to him, but once I did, I ended up doing very well in his class.  Make sure to go to him after class about essays and listen to what he says.  He worked me very hard, but I learned so much from him.
Dr. Hilliard was very hard working and inspiring.  He was always interested in what you had to say.  Great discussions and interesting class.  I would definitely recommend him!!

Takes a while to get used to his teaching methods, but usually has very interesting classes. Grades essays pretty hard, but fair for the most part. He tends to be a little quirky in lectures... Heed his comments and suggestions on essays, and you'll do pretty well.

At first, I did not like his teaching at all.  After time though, the challenges that his class offered and his utmost care for his student's success beat out any grumblings I had with the toughness of his course.  He's a great teacher and helps his students grow as writers and thinkers.
Very demanding in his papers since he is the chair of the English department. Try to avoid him if you can.
awesome prof! Best discussion based class so far...a great facilitator...do your readings!  and participate in class discussion.
